author: kravetsone
abstract: Deploying and maintaining pnpm-workspace + Turborepo monorepos (apps/ + packages/) on self-hosted Coolify v4: the docker-build-context model (Base Directory IS the context; Dockerfile Location is relative to it), watch-paths glob grammar with `!` negation and last-match-wins (verified from Coolify v4.x source with file:line refs), webhook fan-out of one push to N applications, GitHub App vs deploy-key sources, build-pack tradeoffs (Dockerfile vs Nixpacks-in-maintenance vs Railpack-beta vs Docker Compose), turbo prune --docker multi-stage templates for NestJS/Bun/tsx, the four cache layers (same-SHA build skip, Docker layer cache, BuildKit GC daemon.json, Coolify automated cleanup) plus Turborepo local/remote cache, dependency-graph hygiene, a zero-downtime migration runbook, and a symptom→cause→fix troubleshooting table with Coolify issue links.
